verdict.rationale: Zulip's bot framework lets a custom bot be added to a channel and react to messages, and mention notifications only fire for subscribed channels, which together enable an AI agent bot that responds when mentioned — but this requires building/hosting a custom bot via the API rather than a first-party AI agent integration. missing for 10: evidence of a native/pre-built AI agent integration, documentation specifically covering @-mention-triggered AI responses, and any hands-on/community confirmation that such a bot works as described.
